The Ethiopian Government has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Urban Productive Safety Net Project, and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward Payments under the contract for procurement of Personal Safety and protection Materials.

The Asella City Administration Finance office now invites sealed bids from eligible bidders for:

Electronic bidding will not be permitted. Late bids will be rejected. All bids must be accompanied by a "Bid Security "CPO or unconditional Guarantee issued by a Bank for Lot-1, 47,500 Birr Lot 2- 18,700.00 Birr/ and Lot 3- 18,500.00 Birr Totally for Lot 1,2 & 3 are = 84,700.00 /Eight four thousand seven hundred birr only/ from a reputable Bank prepared in the name of Asella City Administration Finance office.
The Asella City Administration Finance office reserves the right to accept or reject all or parts of the bid.
